newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends unchanged in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends unchanged in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended stable on Monday at 41.12 against the dollar in kerb as supply of the U.S. currency matched its demand, dealers said.

"The rupee maintained a firm posture against the dollar as demand for the U.S. currency matched its supply," a dealer said. "The rupee is likely to remain stable in coming days as the dollar has dipped against most currencies in the international market."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.65 percent, from the previous close.
